articles.title: Bangalore Horror: Woman Stabbed 9 Times by Boyfriend Over Suspicion of Infidelity
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bangalore: In a shocking incident in Sunkadakatte, Bangalore, a woman was brutally stabbed nine times by her boyfriend, Priyakar, over suspicions of an immoral relationship.

body.html:
Bangalore: In a shocking incident in Sunkadakatte, Bangalore, a woman was brutally stabbed nine times by her boyfriend, Priyakar, over suspicions of an immoral relationship. The victim, identified as Rekha, a resident of Shira district, succumbed to her injuries despite being rushed to a nearby hospital.

Rekha, a mother of two, had separated from her husband and was living in Bangalore while working in a private company. She had been in a relationship with the accused, Lokesh, who she met at her workplace. Their relationship, which later involved her working as a driver for Lokesh’s company, lasted around four months.

According to reports, the couple had frequent disputes. Lokesh grew suspicious of Rekha, believing she was involved in another relationship, which led to their separation. On Monday, September 22, Lokesh allegedly waited at a bus stop in public and attacked Rekha as she arrived with friends, stabbing her nine times before fleeing the scene.

Local residents immediately took Rekha to the hospital, but doctors were unable to save her. Police have registered a case, and investigations are ongoing to track down the accused.

articles.title: Man Threatens Passengers with Live Snake, Extorts Money
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Panic gripped passengers aboard the Ahmedabad–Sabarmati Express when a man allegedly carried a live snake and began extorting money from commuters. The incident occurred between Mungaoli and Bina junctions in Madhya Pradesh.

body.html:
Panic gripped passengers aboard the Ahmedabad–Sabarmati Express when a man allegedly carried a live snake and began extorting money from commuters. The incident occurred between Mungaoli and Bina junctions in Madhya Pradesh.

A video recorded by a passenger shows the man waving the snake and threatening travelers as he moved through the compartment. Terrified passengers reportedly handed over cash, while some abandoned their seats fearing a snake bite.

The incidents have sparked serious concerns about passenger safety on long-distance trains, particularly in areas with limited security.

The Railway Protection Force (RPF) and Government Railway Police (GRP) have registered cases and initiated investigations. Authorities are working to identify the accused and verify whether the snakes involved were venomous.

articles.title: Barabanki Shock: Massive Python Found Coiled Inside BJP Leader’s Car Bonnet, Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Barabanki (Uttar Pradesh): A terrifying incident unfolded in Satnam Purwa village, Barabanki, when a massive python was discovered inside the bonnet of a car belonging to BJP leader Nagendra Pratap Singh. The shocking discovery was made by the driver while trying to start the vehicle.

body.html:
Barabanki (Uttar Pradesh): A terrifying incident unfolded in Satnam Purwa village, Barabanki, when a massive python was discovered inside the bonnet of a car belonging to BJP leader Nagendra Pratap Singh.

The shocking discovery was made by the driver while trying to start the vehicle. On noticing unusual movement, he opened the bonnet only to find the huge snake coiled near the engine. Panic gripped the area as people ran for safety, while others recorded the incident on their phones.

A viral video shows the python being rescued by Forest Department officials, with a BJP flag visible on the car’s bonnet. A massive crowd gathered as the rescue operation continued for over an hour. Officials later confirmed that the snake was indeed of a very large size.

The reptile was safely rescued and released into a nearby forest. The video of the unusual encounter has since spread rapidly on social media, sparking shock and curiosity.

Aligarh (Uttar Pradesh): A major road accident on the Akrabad Highway turned tragic after a car and a mini truck collided head-on, causing both vehicles to catch fire. Four people were burned alive on the spot, while one person was rushed to hospital in critical condition.

Preliminary reports suggest that the car’s tyre burst, causing it to cross the divider and crash into an oncoming truck. The impact triggered a massive blaze, leaving the victims trapped and leading to a horrific end.

The incident caused chaos in the surrounding area, with locals rushing to the spot. Police and fire brigade teams arrived soon after and worked to douse the flames and bring the situation under control.

articles.title: Mumbai Police Sub-Inspector Caught on Camera Throwing Nameplate During Heated Clash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mumbai: A video from VP Road police station in Girgaon, Mumbai, has gone viral, igniting public outrage and raising serious questions about the conduct of Mumbai Police.

body.html:
Mumbai: A video from VP Road police station in Girgaon, Mumbai, has gone viral, igniting public outrage and raising serious questions about the conduct of Mumbai Police.

The footage, recorded on September 18, 2025, shows Sub-Inspector Durga Kharde in a heated confrontation with a man and woman who approached the station to recover pending payments from an event management firm. Initially, police intervention secured the dues, and the complainants left the station.

The couple later returned, demanding that an FIR be filed against the firm for pending payments to other freelancers. Officers advised that the matter was civil and should be pursued in court. Tensions escalated as Kharde, handling another case, reportedly became frustrated with their loud voices and the video recording. In a shocking moment captured on camera, she removed her nameplate and threw it toward the complainants, prompting widespread criticism.

Following a complaint by the event management company, the police registered a case against the couple for allegedly trespassing into the firm’s office.

The Mumbai Police have confirmed that a formal inquiry has been ordered, with the Assistant Commissioner of Police, Girgaon Division, tasked to investigate the sequence of events and Kharde’s conduct. The incident has reignited debate over accountability and public trust in the city’s police force.

articles.title: Noida Shock: Class 6 Girl Dies in School Under Suspicious Circumstances, Parents Allege Negligence!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | In Noida a Class 6 student of Presidium School, Sector-31, died under mysterious circumstances after collapsing near the washroom. Family alleges negligence, delay in medical aid & contradictory statements by school staff. FIR & probe demanded.

body.html:
#InShort | In Noida a Class 6 student of Presidium School, Sector-31, died under mysterious circumstances after collapsing near the washroom. Family alleges negligence, delay in medical aid & contradictory statements by school staff. FIR & probe demanded.

* * *

Noida – A 10-year-old student of Presidium School, Sector 31, died on September 4 under mysterious circumstances, sparking outrage and allegations of negligence against the school.

The student, Tanishka Sharma (Class 6), collapsed outside the washroom after the lunch break. She was rushed to Kailash Hospital, about 2 km away, where doctors declared her brought dead.

According to the school, the child fainted and fell after choking on food particles. However, her mother, Tripta Sharma, has alleged that the staff gave contradictory versions and delayed taking her to hospital by first treating her in the infirmary.

“The sudden collapse of my daughter, who was hale and hearty before leaving for school, raises serious doubts. Different accounts have been given by the school about how she died. We want the truth,” the mother said in her complaint.

The girl’s uncle, Vaibhav Sharma, alleged that the staff initially claimed she fainted while eating, and later said she collapsed near the stairs. He said the delay in shifting her to hospital may have cost her life.

Police confirmed that an autopsy was videographed and conducted by a medical panel. No external injuries were found, and the viscera has been preserved for forensic analysis. Officers said no foul play has emerged so far, but a clear cause of death will be known only after the viscera report.

The parents filed a complaint on September 8, demanding registration of an FIR and a detailed probe into the school’s emergency response, medical records, staff statements, and CCTV footage.

Meanwhile, a school spokesperson reiterated that food particles had got stuck in the child’s throat during lunch and that she was taken to hospital immediately.

The case remains under investigation.

articles.title: Pakistan Air Force Bombs Its Own Citizens in Khyber: 30 Dead, Women & Children Among Victims
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa: At least 30 people, including women and children, were killed when the Pakistani Air Force (PAF) carried out an airstrike in the Tirah Valley late Monday night.

body.html:
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa: At least 30 people, including women and children, were killed when the Pakistani Air Force (PAF) carried out an airstrike in the Tirah Valley late Monday night. According to reports, eight laser-guided bombs were dropped from Chinese-made JF-17 fighter jets at around 2 AM.

The Pakistan Army claimed the strike targeted a bomb-making facility of Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP). Local police told media that TTP commanders Aman Gul and Masood Khan were making explosives and storing them in mosques. Several videos of the attack are circulating on social media, though their authenticity remains unverified.

However, local residents accused the government and army of conducting operations without proper intelligence, leading to heavy civilian casualties. In June, Amnesty International had criticised Pakistan after a child was killed in a drone strike. In March this year, 10 civilians also died in a similar operation in Katlang, Khyber.

TTP – Pakistan’s Most Dangerous Terrorist Group
Formed in 2007 by Baitullah Mehsud through the merger of 13 extremist factions, the Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan has waged a prolonged insurgency against the Pakistani state. With the return of the Taliban in Afghanistan in 2021, TTP has grown stronger and ended its ceasefire with Pakistan in November 2022, escalating attacks across the country.

The U.S. has previously warned that TTP could gain access to Pakistan’s nuclear arsenal. According to the Global Terrorism Index 2025, Pakistan is now the world’s second most terrorism-affected nation, moving up from fourth place in 2024.

● TTP attacks rose by 90% in 2024.
● BLA attacks increased by 60%.
● IS-K has started targeting urban centres.
● 90% of terrorist incidents occurred in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Balochistan.

The report named TTP as Pakistan’s most dangerous terrorist group for the second consecutive year, carrying out 482 attacks in 2024, which killed 558 people.

articles.title: Giant Python Sparks Chaos in Hyderabad Road — Locals Attack Snake with Stones and Boulders!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Hyderabad (Ghatkesar) – Panic broke out in Pratapsingaram near Ghatkesar when a huge python appeared in the middle of the road on Thursday. A viral video shows the massive snake crawling across the road, halting traffic in both directions.

body.html:
Hyderabad (Ghatkesar) – Panic broke out in Pratapsingaram near Ghatkesar when a huge python appeared in the middle of the road on Thursday. A viral video shows the massive snake crawling across the road, halting traffic in both directions.

Locals, reportedly aware of the snake roaming the village outskirts for days, tried to kill it by throwing stones and beating it with sticks. In the clip, a youth is seen lifting a large boulder and striking the python, though the reptile narrowly escaped and slithered into the bushes.

The person filming can be heard warning bikers, who cautiously passed by the snake. It remains unclear whether the python survived the attack.
